column1: # Measured 2026-08-17 against the sibling `math-education` graph at commit
# ce3e2a5 (2026-08-13, unchanged since): 148 misconception files (147 live,
# This file exists because the 2026-08-13 misconception census was never
# committed. Only its prose survived, in
# "17 out of fragment" could not be re-derived by anyone -- and it does not
# survive re-derivation. See the R3 section of 04-reachability.md.
# Columns: corpus, slug, class, fragment, note.
#   class A -- the obligation is discharged in a fragment axeyum decides today
#           (for a misconception: formalisable and refutable; for a technique:
#           the technique's characteristic obligation is finite by nature).
#   class B -- a genuine obligation, out of every fragment axeyum decides.
#           `fragment` names what it would need. NON-EMPTY EXACTLY FOR B.
#   class C -- not a checkable obligation at all (for a misconception: not a
#           proposition; for a technique: a search heuristic, not a proof step).
#   class DEP -- deprecated in the corpus, excluded from the denominator.
# The A/C boundary is a judgment call and is not what this file is for; the B
# set and its `fragment` column are the load-bearing content, because they are
# the ranked feature request R3 asked for.
# Re-derive the ranking with scripts/check-reachability-census.py, which also
# pins the table in 04-reachability.md against it.
